depends_on: Zhu-Sun IJNT 14 (2018) Thm 1.1 (oddness of a(r,n)/2^n, r>=3; a(n)/6^n odd, r=3)
notes: A225776_pos (OEIS/A225776/A225776_mathlib.lean, Mathlib, axioms propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound): for all r>=2, n>=0, det[f(r,i+j)]_{0..n} > 0 over Z, f(r,k)=Sum_j C(k,j)^r. Proof: f(r,k) = CT(L^k), L=(1+x_1)...(1+x_{r-1})(1+1/(x_1...x_{r-1})) (ct_Lr_pow); L(1/x)=L(x) (refl_Lr), so the Hankel form is CT(Q(x)Q(1/x)) = sum of squared coefficients of Q = Sum c_i L^i (lib OpenProblemsLib.MomentHankel.hankel_posDef); powers of L independent by evaluation at x_1=t, others 1, and Vandermonde (Lr_indep). Outside Lean: oddness of a(r,n)/2^n for r>=3 and a(n)/6^n odd for r=3 stay cited to Zhu-Sun Thm 1.1 (not proved here).

sources.cite: B.-X. Zhu, Z.-W. Sun, Hankel-type determinants for some combinatorial sequences, IJNT 14 (2018), arXiv:1609.06810, Theorem 1.1
